L01_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L01_narrator.wav.text: Today, I'd like to tell you a bit about my hometown.

L02_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L02_narrator.wav.text: It is located in the northern part of the country.

L03_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L03_narrator.wav.text: Most people think it gets too cold in the winter.

L04_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L04_narrator.wav.text: Actually, the snow makes the whole city look magical.

L05_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L05_narrator.wav.text: Our town is famous for fresh seafood and warm noodle soup.

L06_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L06_narrator.wav.text: You can find a great bowl of ramen on almost every corner.

L07_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L07_narrator.wav.text: If you visit, you must stop at the historic central park.

L08_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L08_narrator.wav.text: You can rent a bicycle and ride around the peaceful lake.

L09_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L09_narrator.wav.text: The local people are kind and always willing to help visitors.

L10_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L10_narrator.wav.text: Life moves at a relaxed pace compared to big cities.

L11_narrator.wav.speaker: narrator
L11_narrator.wav.text: I hope you will take the chance to visit someday soon.
